extension.summary: Watch live sports, 24/7 channels, replays, and TiviMate Multi-View from Sportsurge & StreamEast
extension.description: Kodi add-on for Sportsurge & StreamEast. Features TiviMate Multi-View (2-screen split & 4-screen quad-box) with built-in IPTV proxy server, high-res category art, dedicated LIVE NOW section, league sub-filters (NFL, NBA, EPL, F1), one-click buffer optimizer, quick channel zapping, auto-updates, 24/7 TV networks, and match replays with Real-Debrid / AllDebrid.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not host or distribute any video content. It merely parses publicly accessible web links.
extension.news: v1.4.0: - TiviMate Multi-View & PiP Integration (2-screen, 3-screen, and 4-screen quad-box multi-game watching). - Built-in Kodi IPTV Proxy Server running locally on port 8899 with zero-latency loopback. - Dynamic manifest & TS chunk rewriter injecting upstream headers to eliminate 403 Forbidden errors. - 1-Click M3U Playlist Export to Firestick storage (/sdcard/Download/) and local network sharing. - Interactive Remote Control Guide for instant audio switching using D-pad arrows.
